patterns.note: The site uses a dark, spacious, full-width layout with distinct sections, often featuring asymmetrical arrangements where text content is paired with large, dynamic visuals or 3D renders.
Headings are large, bold, and sans-serif, providing strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text, maintaining a modern and technical aesthetic.
A dominant dark background (near-black) provides a stark contrast for white or light gray text, with vibrant purple, blue, and pink hues from the 3D graphics serving as primary accent colors.
The top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
The hero section features a dynamic, interactive 3D environment that cycles through different scenes, acting as a visual showcase for the platform's capabilities.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a dynamic 3D environment, likely built with WebGL/Three.js, to showcase product features and capabilities, presented within a carousel that transitions between different interactive scenes.
The main navigation bar employs a sticky position, ensuring it remains visible and accessible at the top of the viewport during scroll.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the user's viewport, creating a guided and engaging scrolling experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, highly legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are used on interactive elements and card backgrounds, maintaining a modern and polished feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing is used throughout, particularly in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of openness and allowing visuals to breathe.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dynamic, interactive 3D environments and visuals, particularly in the hero and throughout the content sections, elevates it beyond a typical marketing site. This immersive visual storytelling, combined with a dark, futuristic aesthetic, makes the complex technical offerings feel tangible and engaging.
